notes:
The loading screen should clear now.

Your inventory bar was never being built. The server looks up the object that owns your quickbar slots, and on 7.40 it was looking for it under the wrong name — so nothing ever told the game which item belongs in which slot. Your game received the items, could not place a single one, and waited on a loading screen for an inventory that was never going to arrive. The only sign of it in the log was one line reading "Failed to find property 'QuickBars'", which looked harmless.

It now tries both names this property goes by, and if a future build renames it again, finds the object directly by who owns it — which cannot be misspelled. The result is checked before it is used, so a wrong match is ignored rather than trusted.

If this is the last thing standing between you and a match, the loading screen should now give way to the island.
